entries.title: A reply keeps its card, and Put aside and Close say what they do
entries.body: Replying under a card no longer takes it away: it stays on your screen beside its thread, even with other cards waiting. Minimize is now called Put aside, and a card you put aside comes back on its own when it changes. Close says where the card stays readable. If you close a card while your reply is still unanswered, you are asked first, with Put aside instead as the choice that keeps the answer coming back to you.

picture.alt: Closing a decision with an unanswered reply asks first, offering Put aside instead beside Close anyway
